key_insight: Thin single-crystal perovskite detectors can effectively detect high-energy charged particles.
engineering_relevance: These detectors offer advantages in tracking and real-time monitoring for high-energy particles without complex bonding processes.
method: Developed a thin OMHP crystal, approximately 150 micrometers thick.
Employs a dewetting technique for direct growth on patterned substrates.
Designed dedicated electronics to align with crystal time characteristics.
evidence_signal: This work represents the first instance of thin OMHP crystals detecting high energy charged particles exceeding hundreds of MeV.
watch_item: Further investigation is needed to assess long-term stability and performance under continuous radiation exposure.
paper_title: Thin single-crystal perovskite detector for high-energy charged particles
